title: FineVLA: Fine-Grained Instruction Alignment for Steerable Vision-Language-Action Policies
abstract: arXiv:2605.27284v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are increasingly expected to not only complete robot tasks, but also follow human instructions about how those tasks should be executed. However, existing robot datasets usually pair trajectories with coarse goal-level language, leaving execution-critical details such as active arm, approach direction, and contact region unspecified. This limits steerable policy learning and robotic video understanding. We introduce FineVLA, an open framework for action-aligned fine-grained VLA supervision. translated_title: FineVLA：面向可操控视觉-语言-动作策略的细粒度指令对齐
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型被越来越期望不仅能够完成机器人任务，还能遵循关于任务执行方式的人类指令。然而，现有的机器人数据集通常将轨迹与粗粒度的目标级语言配对，未指明执行关键细节，例如活动手臂、接近方向和接触区域。这限制了可操控策略学习和机器人视频理解。我们提出FineVLA，一个用于动作对齐细粒度VLA监督的开源框架。该框架包括：(1) 一个数据构建工具，统一了来自10个开源机器人数据集的85K个任务中的972,247条轨迹，并构建了FineVLA-Data——一个经人工验证的包含47,159条细粒度轨迹的数据集；(2) 一个包含500个视频、11,631个原子事实和1,030个VQA问题的保留基准测试集；(3) 一个面向机器人领域的专用VLM标注器，用于可扩展的细粒度标注；(4) 一个可操控……
tldr: FineVLA提出了一个开源框架，通过统一10个开源机器人数据集的97万余条轨迹构建人工验证的细粒度轨迹数据集、保留基准测试集和机器人专用VLM标注器，实现对VLA策略的动作对齐细粒度监督，使其能够遵循指定执行细节（如活动手臂、接近方向、接触区域）的人类指令。
en_tdlr: FineVLA introduces an open framework for action-aligned fine-grained VLA supervision that unifies 972K trajectories from 10 open-source robot datasets into a human-verified fine-grained dataset, along with a held-out benchmark and a robotics-specialized VLM annotator, enabling steerable policies that follow execution-level instructions such as active arm, approach direction, and contact region.
